retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic central figure interacting with a geometric grid of large, colorful translucent circles and bold striped patterns.
excludeWhen: organic fluid shapes without a grid

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in a high-energy, star-jump pose wearing vibrant vertical rainbow stripes, set against a white background populated by a 4x4 grid of large, semi-transparent colored circles that overlap the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject limbs aligned with the diagonal axis of the circular grid
Translucent circles creating color shifts where they overlap the striped clothing
Text following the curved perimeter of specific circles
High-contrast interaction between the white negative space and saturated primary colors
coreInvariants: A 4x4 grid of large uniform circles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale figure occupying the majority of the vertical and horizontal space in a dynamic X-pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the red-tinted palm of the raised hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the diagonal limbs from the center outward to the corners, guided by the circular grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white background visible between the grid of circles and the subject's limbs.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Multi-colored rainbow stripes (red, yellow, blue, green, purple).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Translucent pastel circles in cyan, magenta, lime, and orange.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements with varying transparency levels in the circular overlays.

composition.position: curved around the top and side of specific circles

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying path orientations.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity of the layout.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person in a dynamic star-jump pose wearing a vertical rainbow-striped jumpsuit against a white background. Overlay a 4x4 grid of large, semi-transparent circles in cyan, magenta, lime, and orange, ensuring the circles tint the subject where they overlap.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase geometric sans-serif text following the outer top curve of the top-center circle and the outer right curve of the middle-right circle using wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Text follows the circular path of the grid elements
Circles are translucent and blend with the subject
Subject is wearing vertical rainbow stripes

postGenerationChecks: Check that circles are perfectly circular and aligned to a grid
Ensure the rainbow stripes are vertical and high-contrast
Verify text is lowercase and follows the circle perimeter
Confirm the white background is clean and free of artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Dynamic subject + vertical stripes + 4x4 translucent circle grid + curved geometric sans-serif typography.
